# UDreamExpandableArea

<!-- Generated by the DreamGUIReferenceDocs commandlet from reflection. Edit the header, not this page. -->

Inherits from [UDreamUIControl](DreamUIControl.md).

Declared in `Public/Controls/DreamExpandableArea.h`.

A header that toggles, and the content it hides.

Three nodes and one behaviour: a column, a clickable header face with an indicator and a label on
it, and a content column below. The header is a UUIButton on its own face, exactly as DreamButton
builds one -- an expander IS a button whose click means "show the rest" -- so hover, press and
navigation come from the library's one selectable rather than from a second interaction story.

HOW A CONSUMER PUTS CONTENT IN IT, and which idiom that is, because there are two in this codebase
and only one is reachable from here:

    Native.ExpandableArea Details {
        Label = "Advanced"
        Text Body { Text = "..." }

| Function | Kind | Description |

| `UDreamWidget* GetContent()` | pure | The first widget in the content column, or null while it is empty. |

| `void SetExpansionDuration(float InExpansionDuration)` | callable | How long the NEXT open or close takes. Nothing is re-run: a duration describes a move that has not happened yet, and replaying the current one to honour a new speed would animate a section the player already finished opening. |
| `void SetIsExpanded(bool bInIsExpanded)` | callable | Silent when the flag does not move; otherwise pushes the visuals and broadcasts both events. |
| `void SetLabel(FText InLabel)` | callable | The words on the header, written through to the label the control owns. |
| `void SetMaxHeight(float InMaxHeight)` | callable | Re-measures at once: the ceiling is part of the height this control claims. |
| `void SetStyle(FDreamExpandableAreaStyle InStyle)` | callable | This instance's whole look, replaced and pushed. See UDreamButton::SetStyle for the caveat. |
| `void ToggleExpansion()` | callable | What the header click does, callable without a pointer. |

## Compared with UMG

Every Blueprint-facing member of the UMG class, and where it went. *adopt*: same name, same meaning. *map*: here under another name or on another type. *reject*: deliberately absent, with the reason.

| UMG | Member | Status | Here | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `UExpandableArea` | `Style` | adopt | `Style` | FDreamExpandableAreaStyle: the header's height, its five state colours, the label, and the content area's background and padding. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `BorderBrush` | map | `FDreamExpandableAreaStyle::ContentBackground` | A colour rather than an FSlateBrush: the content area is a procedural rect, and what an expander's frame is in this family is that rect's fill. A picture behind the content is a Native.Border around it. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `BorderColor` | map | `FDreamExpandableAreaStyle::ContentBackground` | One colour where UMG has a brush and a tint over it, for the reason above: there is no brush here for a second colour to multiply. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `bIsExpanded` | adopt | `bIsExpanded` | Authored open or closed; every road that CHANGES it goes through SetIsExpanded, which is what broadcasts. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `MaxHeight` | adopt | `MaxHeight` | Zero is no ceiling, which is what this control has always done. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `HeaderPadding` | map | `FDreamExpandableAreaStyle::HeaderPadding` | In the style, because how a project's section headers are inset is a theme decision. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `AreaPadding` | map | `FDreamExpandableAreaStyle::ContentPadding` | Named for what it pads rather than for the widget it sits on. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `OnExpansionChanged` | adopt | `OnExpansionChanged` | Fires from a click and from code alike. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `GetIsExpanded` | adopt | `GetIsExpanded` |  |
| `UExpandableArea` | `SetIsExpanded` | adopt | `SetIsExpanded` |  |
| `UExpandableArea` | `SetIsExpanded_Animated` | map | `ExpansionDuration` | A duration rather than a second function: whether an expander animates is a property of the expander, not of the caller, so every road (a click, a binding, code) gets the same open. Zero is instant, which is what every expander already authored does. |
| `UExpandableArea` | `SetStyle` | adopt | `SetStyle` | UExpandableArea has no style setter at all (its Style is EditAnywhere only); this is the family's spelling of replacing a look at runtime. |
